docs.text:
Disposition of Asset by Subsidiary

Please be informed that the Company's subsidiary, Discovery Fleet Corporation ("DFC") has executed a Deed of Absolute Sale with VCoast Marine Services for the sale of its vessel, M/Y Discovery Palawan, for a consideration of Php 3 Million.After careful evaluation by DFC's Board and Management, it was determined that continuing the liveaboard business line was no longer viable due to the vessel's aging condition and sustained financial losses from its operations.

docs.title: KEEPR: Acquisition or Disposition of Shares of Another Corporation
docs.text:
Acquisition of up to 50% Subscribed and Outstanding Shares of Cervia Global Trading, Inc.

The Keepers Holdings, Inc. ("Keepers") intends to acquire up to 50% subscribed and outstanding shares of Cervia Global Trading, Inc.

The acquisition of a 50% stake in Cervia Global Trading, Inc. gives The Keepers Holdings, Inc. a strategic entry point into the premium local spirits market, while also positioning the company for growth in international markets

The Keepers Holdings, Inc. shall pay cash to Mr. Caesar R. Certeza, Mr. Mark Daniel L. Rivera, Mr. Vernon A. Carandang, and Ms. Margherita Y. Rauto in exchange of their respective shareholdings, totaling to fifty percent (50%) of the subscribed and outstanding capital stock of Cervia Global Trading, Inc.

Cervia Global Trading, Inc. is a domestic corporation and the company behind the world-class Filipino liqueur brand “SULÀ”. It is dedicated to creating and producing premium local alcoholic beverages – particularly liqueurs using Philippine-grown raw materials for distribution in both domestic and international markets.

The consideration shall be paid in cash

The amount of consideration was based on the revenue potential of Cervia Global Trading, Inc.

One-time payment

The acquisition of a 50% stake in Cervia Global Trading, Inc. gives The Keepers Holdings, Inc. a strategic entry point into the premium local spirits market, while also positioning the company for growth in international markets

docs.title: FB: Declaration of Cash Dividends
docs.text:
Declaration of Regular Cash Dividends for Common Shares.

Please be informed that at the meeting of the Board of Directors of San Miguel Food and Beverage, Inc. (respectively, the "Board" and the "Company") held on November 10, 2025, the Board approved the declaration of a regular cash dividend of P0.50 per share, for common shareholders of the Company as of record date of November 25, 2025. Payment date is December 10, 2025.

RETAINED EARNINGS AS OF SEPTEMBER 30, 2025 AND RECEIPT OF DIVIDEND INCOME FROM SUBSIDIARIES.

Declaration of Special Cash Dividends for Common Shares.

Please be informed that at the meeting of the Board of Directors of San Miguel Food and Beverage, Inc. (respectively, the "Board" and the Company") held on November 10, 2025, the Board approved the declaration of a special cash dividend of P0.55 per share, for common shareholders of the Company as of record date of November 25, 2025. Payment date is December 10, 2025.

RETAINED EARNINGS AS OF SEPTEMBER 30, 2025 AND RECEIPT OF DIVIDEND INCOME FROM SUBSIDIARIES.
